title: Choose the visual world
question: Which world should carry llmdeepdive across the homepage, tracks, lessons, search, and transformer explorer?

options.label: Abyssal Core Atlas
options.lineage: bathymetric surveys · geological core atlases · transformer cutaways
options.body: The course becomes a scientific descent from surface intuition to model internals. A cutaway transformer core owns the first viewport; eight depth bands become the curriculum map; contours, section hatching, and evidence markers organize every dense lesson. Signature interaction: the learner follows one signal path down through layers, then resurfaces by teaching it back. It scales naturally to track maps, long-form lessons, quizzes, search, and the existing 3D anatomy. Honest risk: the depth metaphor must encode real hierarchy and never become ocean decoration.

options.label: Annotated Knowledge Spread
options.lineage: Japanese street-fashion magazine density fused with technical annotation
options.body: Every mechanism is pulled forward like a cut-out figure and surrounded by hand-led callouts, arrows, definitions, and evidence tags. The first viewport becomes an exuberant transformer spread; lessons become dense annotated plates. It makes relationships impossible to miss, but the hot-pink, gold, glitter-outline grammar risks overpowering long-form reading and the course's evidentiary tone.

options.label: Evidence Filmstrip
options.lineage: hand-processed 16mm film fused with the learning loop
options.body: Concept, analogy, lab, teach-back, and quiz become exposed frames in a physical strip; citations and caveats live as edge codes, and orange light leaks mark the active frame. Sequence and progress become extremely clear, but the distressed emulsion language identifies more strongly with cinema than with model systems and would impose darkness on reading-heavy surfaces.
